idea-plugin.name: Session Porter for Claude Code
idea-plugin.description:
Export and import Claude Code chat sessions - built for moving them to another machine and another user.

The plugin reads the local Claude Code session transcripts (~/.claude/projects/<project>/<sessionId>.jsonl), the auxiliary folder next to each transcript and the file history behind checkpoints and /rewind (~/.claude/file-history/<sessionId>), lets you pick the conversations you want to move and writes them into a portable ZIP archive. On import, the sessions are attached to the local project folder you choose, conflicts are resolved the way you pick (skip, replace or import as a new copy) and the timestamps are shifted so the sessions show up as ones that just happened: run claude --resume from that folder and they are listed right away, with no restart. Every import writes a diagnostic log.

  • Tools | Claude Code sessions | Export Sessions... pick one or more sessions and save the archive.
  • Tools | Claude Code sessions | Import Sessions... pick an archive, the target project folder and which sessions to restore.

The interface follows the language of the IDE or of the operating system: English, Italian, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese and Korean.

The plugin is loaded right after installation, with no IDE restart, and works entirely offline: it collects no data and never connects to any server. Open source under the MIT License - source code, privacy policy, issue tracker.
